title: Pause-on-open (r3 gate demand c, half) remains unpinned — parity replaces the app effect hooks with counters, so the Run->Paused transition executes in zero tests
evidence: harness/parity.odin: "// parity_settings_press_effect — the settings chip/row press (7.3), the parity" / "// twin of the app's settings_click: mirrors the INPUT-STATE mutations (panel" / "// open/close + focus + the row-adjust), with the app effects (pause-on-open," / "// persist) nil-safe by construction — parity asserts the input surface + the" / "// empty command stream, not the app side effects." and "if settings_rec != nil {" / "ictx.user = settings_rec // the recorder hooks cast user (the app's real user is the App)" / "ictx.on_settings = parity_settings_hook" / "ictx.on_settings_adjust = parity_settings_adjust_hook". parity_settings_hook body is only "r.opens += 1". The assert (input_parity_settings_panel): "if runs[i].panel_opens < 1 {" / "append(fails, fmt.tprintf("  %s %v: %d settings-opens (want >=1 — the chip/S/Y open must reach the on_settings effect)", sc.name, devs[i], runs[i].panel_opens))". grep 'effect_settings' across harness/ returns no match.
detail: The r3 gate-FAIL blocker demanded one startup-apply AND one pause-on-open assert. Only startup-apply landed (settings_startup_apply). Deleting effect_settings's app.mode = .Paused fails no CI test.
recommended_fix: Extract the pause-on-open transition (like a11y_apply) and unit-assert Run->Paused on open, stays Paused after close.

title: Workflow mirror still broken: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs only `odin test core` — gate 2's four test binaries (app x3, render, audio, harness) execute in no GitHub gate
evidence: ci.yml line 70: "        run: odin test core" — the file's only `odin test` step. The chunk-rest diff touches tools/ci-local.sh only: "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test" — no .github/workflows hunk exists in the diff (file list: goldens/, harness/, tools/ only). grep 'odin test' .github/workflows/ci.yml matches line 70 alone.
detail: r3 gate demand (b) required gate 2 AND the workflow mirror. The local gate landed (including the 3x repeat leg and app/audio); the ci.yml mirror did not — the four new test binaries, incl. the oracle negative leg, never run remotely.
recommended_fix: Mirror gate 2 in ci.yml: odin test core + 3x odin test app + app/render + app/audio + harness test binaries.

title: a11y_reduced and a11y_scale goldens have no presence/content oracle — palcheck's mode scan covers only the three palette modes, so the reduced-motion static pin and x1.50 chrome are bless-trust only
evidence: palcheck.odin: "base := rnd.palette_load()" / "modes := []rnd.Palette_Mode{.Deutan, .Protan, .Tritan}" / "for mode in modes {" — the loop generating presence checks (state-critical renders, map water/park, base-water-absent) iterates the three palette modes only; grep 'a11y_reduced|a11y_scale|reduced' over palcheck.odin returns no match for those goldens. Spec AC: "Given reduced-motion + an active crisis, when the a11y_reduced golden captures, then ring/outline widths are static and the banner + glyph + readouts render (crisis readability contract)."
detail: The reduced-motion readability AC and the E9.3 scaled-chrome AC are verified only by byte-comparison to freshly blessed goldens — nothing mechanically distinguishes a static-width capture from a mid-pulse one, or scaled chrome from unscaled. r3 carry-forward, unaddressed.
recommended_fix: Extend palcheck: diff a11y_reduced crisis frames at two ticks (must be identical) and count scaled-chrome geometry (e.g. banner width > base) in a11y_scale.

title: x1.25 scale step has no golden, no parity leg, and no scenario anywhere — only x1.00 (identity) and x1.50 are exercised
evidence: a11y_scale.dem: "a11y scale 150" (the only scale demo; no 125 demo exists in demos/). harness/parity.odin run_input_parity: "view: rnd.View" / "view.catalogs = cat" / "pal := rnd.palette_load()" / "view.palette = &pal" / "rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)" — the parity view never sets ui_scale. demo.odin accepts "case 125: rc.view.ui_scale = 1.25" in apply_demo_a11y but no demo exercises it.
detail: r3 warning carry-forward: the spec's min-window 1152x648 AC and the x1.25 layout (the r3 SLA-collision scale) remain verified only by unit constants in hud_test. Unaddressed in this chunk.
recommended_fix: Add an a11y_scale125 demo + blessed golden (or a parity/settings scenario driving the scale row twice) pinning the x1.25 layout.

title: panel_adjust_row is recorded per device but never asserted — settings_press adjusting the wrong row still passes parity
evidence: parity.odin: "panel_adjust_row: i32, // the LAST recorded adjust row" and the scenario assert: "if runs[i].panel_adjusts < 1 {" / "append(fails, fmt.tprintf("  %s %v: %d settings-adjust calls (want >=1 — the row activation must reach the adjust effect)", sc.name, devs[i], runs[i].panel_adjusts))" — grep 'panel_adjust_row' shows only the field declaration (81) and the copy (267); no check_states comparison exists.
detail: The scenario focuses row 1 before activating; asserting adjust_row == 1 per device would pin the focus-follows-activation chain. Currently only the call count bites.
recommended_fix: In input_parity_settings_panel, assert runs[i].panel_adjust_row == 1 on every device.

title: a11y demo-verb parse-error legs untested — the six 'bad a11y' error paths in parse_demo run in no test
evidence: demo.odin: "return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad a11y (want: a11y palette <name> | a11y reduced | a11y scale <pct>): %s", line)" and "return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad a11y palette (deutan|protan|tritan): %s", line)" and "return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad a11y scale (100|125|150): %s", line)". grep 'parse_demo' across harness/ matches only overlay.odin:34, run.odin:257/673 (runtime callers) — no test drives parse_demo with malformed a11y lines.
detail: Happy-path-only coverage of the new parser surface; an unknown mode name or bad pct silently passing to a default would fail no gate. r3 carry-forward, unaddressed.
recommended_fix: Add a harness unit test feeding bad a11y lines ('a11y palette bogus', 'a11y scale 110', 'a11y') expecting non-empty error strings.

title: The parity suite never runs under any a11y mode or scale — the 'full input parity holds under every mode' AC stays construction-argued
evidence: run_input_parity: "view: rnd.View" / "view.catalogs = cat // the render package reads the catalogs (tray chip count/rects)" / "pal := rnd.palette_load()" / "view.palette = &pal" / "rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)" — no palette_apply_mode, reduced_motion, or ui_scale set anywhere in run_input_parity or drive_parity. Spec AC: "Given the settings panel, when driven by mouse, then touch, then controller, then the emitted Intent sequences are identical (parity runner green)."
detail: r3 note carry-forward: parity scenarios all run at defaults, so mode/scale-dependent hit-rects (settings chip/rows, QoS rects under scaling) are never parity-checked under those modes. Unaddressed.
recommended_fix: Add one parity leg applying a11y mode + x1.50 to the shared view before build_scenarios (rects recompute; end-states must still match).

title: derive_a11y_palettes.py runs in no gate and its Machado matrices/thresholds duplicate the Odin oracle with no cross-check
evidence: grep 'derive_a11y' across tools/ci-local.sh, tools/harness.sh, .github/workflows/ci.yml returns zero matches. The script's verify(): "return [(lab, a, b, t) for lab, a, b, t in pair_list(mode, remap, classes)" / "if dist(simulate(a, mode), simulate(b, mode)) < t]" duplicates palcheck.odin's a11y_separation_check: "da := cvd_dist(cvd_simulate(pr[0], m), cvd_simulate(pr[1], m))" / "if da < threshold { fails += 1 }". r3 note carry-forward, unaddressed.
detail: The derivation record can drift from the shipped tables unnoticed (the script emits tables nobody must paste). Only the Odin oracle runs in CI. Low risk — palcheck is the binding gate — but the doc's 'derivation record' claim is unverified.
recommended_fix: Add a gate leg running the script in verify-only mode and asserting all-clear (or diffing its emitted modes against data/palette.json).
